title: TAI general-agro answer completeness and activation acceptance repair
objective: Repair the production activation failure where local Qwen recognized a drip-irrigation question but returned an answer without concrete design variables, while preserving model-first behavior and the existing broad live acceptance standard.
boundaries: Do not weaken, remove, skip or make optional any RU, EN, ZH, SSE, Chromium, mobile, subject-relevance or substantive-factor acceptance assertion
General-agro answers must remain model-first; deterministic server logic may add only a bounded stable completeness floor when the generated answer omits concrete applicable factors

The completeness floor must be category-based and reusable across crop production, irrigation, livestock, machinery, storage, farm infrastructure, economics and farm IT rather than a single hard-coded answer
No agronomic dose, pesticide rate, veterinary medicine, machinery specification, diagnostic code, compatibility claim, current price, current law or production status may be fabricated
A selection, design or diagnostic answer must name at least two applicable observable or measurable decision factors before asking for clarification
Any server-added completeness text must be safe, non-executable, read-only, free of exact current claims and exposed through a distinct safety flag
Private model transport, HMAC authority, role and tenant boundaries, secret redaction, no-write guarantees and current-evidence controls remain unchanged
Activation failure evidence must retain the actual failed public answer and completed-case metadata so the next failure is directly diagnosable
The activation workflow must run when the restricted public Qwen service or its tests change
The fixed socket.io-parser 4.2.7 must replace every production resolution of 4.2.6; no security exception is permitted for GHSA-2m8v-j782-fhvr
brace-expansion 2.1.4 and 5.0.9 must replace the affected 2.1.2 and 5.0.8 resolutions; no exception is permitted for GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895
No paid model, SaaS, hosting, database or recurring cost is added

Production completion requires exact-head CI, exact-main merge, canonical images, full-stack REG.RU release, successful preflight, restricted Qwen activation, broad endpoint and mobile Chromium acceptance, finalization and post-deployment verification
The failed activation must remain rolled back until a new exact-main activation reaches terminal PASS
